title: Heavy and Unbalanced
text:
Heavy and Unbalanced. I really wanted to like this but there are quite a few design issues that prevent me from giving this more than 3 stars.

Likes:
Assembles easily
Dirt cup empties well. No filter in the middle to get everything hung up on.
OK suction out of the box. But most of these kinds of vacs are good for about 6 months before they start to decline in that regard.

Dislikes:
Very heavy and poorly balanced. I have a one level house and by the time I had gone around one room getting the dust bunnies, my shoulder was aching. This thing is very lightweight from the floor attachment upwards. The motor is disproportionately heavy causing a continual struggle to keep the vacuum grounded to the floor. When held at a comfortable angle, the motor practically lifts the floor attachment off the floor. I cannot honestly see doing anything over your head with this.

In that same vein, I put the stair attachment on to go over some furniture. Awful balance. It is a constant struggle to hold this without it trying to turn over in your hand.

The battery when fully charged barely lasted for the 15 minutes it took to go from one end of my house on one level and 3 pieces of furniture before the indicator was showing low.

This will be relegated to a back up vacuum when my Hoover of a similar style dies.
